comment: What the Studio's computer export downloads on first use, pinned here and compiled into the app (studio_local/components.rs). Each archive is checked against its SHA-256 before it is unpacked, and each binary against its own after. Node is the local agent's pin (local_agent/runtime.json).

chrome.comment: Chrome's headless shell at the version the worker's Remotion is tested with (@remotion/renderer dist/browser/get-chrome-download-url.js TESTED_VERSION), from the same places Remotion downloads it: on a Mac with Apple silicon Remotion's own build (remotion.media), on Windows Google's Chrome for Testing. SHA-256s computed from the downloaded archives on 2026-11-13 (neither host publishes one). Bump with @remotion/renderer.

ffmpeg.comment: PLACEHOLDER: our LGPL FFmpeg and ffprobe with the system encoders (VideoToolbox, Media Foundation), built by studio-worker/scripts and hosted by us. Not built yet: null url and hashes make the status say FFmpeg is not available for this version yet. Fill each target from the build's own output (a zip holding <prefix>/ffmpeg and <prefix>/ffprobe, .exe on Windows), with the archive's and each binary's SHA-256 and size.
